artists.source_line: • 🎓 10 hours of intensive workshops with the brilliant Jovany Kizatours & Céline.

Dreamed of it? Chill & Trip made it happen. Forget standard dance workshops; we’re launching a unique concept that blends the prestige of a 5-star luxury resort with the authentic soul of Cape Verde. 🌍✨

features.rationale: The description states that 10 hours of workshops are part of the package.
The workshops are explicitly described as intensive.
The 24-hour All-Inclusive package includes gourmet buffets and drinks.
